name: Dwarf & Dragon

features.name: Splitting symbols
features.description: Split in half and double their value.

features.name: Multiplier egg wilds
features.description: 2x–10x wilds that pay twice when split.

review:
Dwarf & Dragon is a 5x4 fantasy slot with lamps, dynamite, hammers and maps. Splitting symbols divide in half and double their value, creating bigger wins.

Golden dragon-egg wilds substitute for other symbols and can carry 2x, 3x, 5x or 10x multipliers, which pay twice if the wild splits. Three, four or five bonus symbols award 10, 15 or 25 free spins, which can be retriggered. Pragmatic Play describes it as a high volatility slot. Its page and in-game screens give different maximums, so we haven't listed one. Note the RTP is 95.54%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: No confirmed official max win figure
